locked_features.h3_higher_norms: L4/L2, L8/L2, L16/L2 and Linfinity/L2 of 50-cell local impact susceptibility, where each cell is absolute adjacent price distance in bps divided by displayed BTC
locked_features.h6_h94_power_law: five-minute trailing log-linear fits of 5-BTC sweep cost to A(T-t)^(-alpha), searching prospective T in 10,20,30,60,120,300 seconds; score is positive alpha times R-squared divided by T
locked_features.h7_self_similarity: negative trailing 60-second mean Euclidean change in profiles interpolated after price-width and total-depth normalization
locked_features.h16_lead_time: out-of-sample incremental average precision of higher-norm and gradient features beyond spread, depth, imbalance, realized volatility, activity and signed flow at 10, 30 and 60 seconds
locked_features.h25_microbursts: negative OLS slope of log inter-trade intervals over the most recent 50 trades
locked_features.h27_fine_to_coarse: log ratio of within-bin 100ms trade-price realized variance to squared 10-second trade-price return
locked_features.h28_wavelet: high-to-low Haar energy ratio over trailing 64 one-second signed-flow observations
locked_features.h29_multifractal: absolute difference between q=1 and q=4 generalized scaling exponents estimated at 1,2,4,8-second aggregation over a trailing five-minute window
locked_features.h30_cross_scale: trailing 60-second correlation between absolute one-second signed flow and absolute ten-second rolling signed flow
locked_features.h93_regularity: trailing 60-second integral of local gradient maximum; safe threshold is its training-only 20th percentile
locked_features.h94_critical_time: power-law score and fitted prospective critical time, evaluated without future inputs

primary_gate: augmented test average-precision improvement greater than 0.02 and positive Brier improvement
targeted_gate: positive Spearman correlation and strictly positive 95% interval for high-minus-low future excursion using 10-minute test blocks and 1000 deterministic bootstrap resamples
h3_gate: higher-p norm ratios must show non-decreasing incremental average precision at both 30 and 60 seconds and the Linfinity ratio must improve over baseline at 10 seconds
h93_gate: test jump rate in the training-defined safe region at most one quarter of the unsafe rate and Wilson 95% upper bound below the overall test event rate
interpretation: Because this day has already been inspected, any positive finding is hypothesis generation only and requires a new untouched whole-day replication. A negative result rejects only these locked implementations.
